name: Doctrine Feature
summary: Enforcement Doctrine Feature Riot Shield While using a shield, you gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks. Executioner Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, another hostile creature within 30 ft must make a Wisdom save or become frightened until your next turn. Investigator Once per short rest, ask the GM one tactical question about a creature, device, crime scene, or battlefield; the GM answers truthfully but briefly.
